run_reconstruction: run the dynamic NeRF reconstruction pipeline with pose optimization and focal length refinement on a dataset
run_render_test: render novel views from a trained checkpoint and compute PSNR SSIM and other test metrics
run_export_mesh: export a trained TensoRF model to a PLY mesh file using dense alpha thresholding
review_reconstruction: review the reconstruction function which trains static and dynamic TensoRF models with multiple loss terms including RGB distortion TV and flow losses
review_SimpleSampler: review the SimpleSampler class that provides batch-wise random sampling indices for training iterations
